an4.178:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.178:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:1.5: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na adhimuccati
an4.178:1.6: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho
an4.178:1.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso lapagatena hatthena sākhaṃ gaṇheyya tassa so hattho sajjeyyapi gaṇheyyapi bajjheyyapi
an4.178:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:1.10: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati
an4.178:1.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:2.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:2.3: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati
an4.178:2.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho
an4.178:2.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso suddhena hatthena sākhaṃ gaṇheyya tassa so hattho neva sajjeyya na gaṇheyya na bajjheyya
an4.178:2.6: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:2.8: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati
an4.178:2.9: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:3.3: tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati
an4.178:3.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikakhuno na avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho
an4.178:3.6: tassā puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya devo ca na sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya
an4.178:3.7: evaṃ hi tassā bhikkhave jambāliyā na ālippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho
an4.178:3.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:3.10: avijjāppabhede manasikaroti tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāppabhedaṃ cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati
an4.178:3.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:4.3: tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati
an4.178:4.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho
an4.178:4.6: tassā puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya devo ca sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya
an4.178:4.7: evaṃ hi tassā bhikkhave jambāliyā ālippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho
an4.178:4.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.178:4.10: tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati
an4.178:4.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:4.12: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
